decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX is an evolution of the well-received BASIC 518 trommel screen, which gives it an established customer base in the firm's core screening line.
The AK flail shredder series is a core product line that was recently upgraded to EU Stage V engines, showing continued investment.
The mobile high-speed grinder sits in the firm's core mobile shredding segment, and it moved to a page of its own in 2019, suggesting it gained importance.

The new CERON generation is positioned as a benchmark in stationary pre-shredding and has documented installations, though stationary machines are a less central segment that a sibling stationary product has already left.
